help.stress: Stress is a special reserve of fortitude and luck. When you resist a consequence, you suffer 6 stress minus the highest die result. Push yourself — take 2 stress for each: add +1d to your roll, add +1 level to your effect, or take action when you’re incapacitated. When you mark your last stress box, you suffer a level of trauma.
help.trauma: When you mark your last stress box, you suffer trauma: circle one of your trauma conditions. You’re taken out of action and come back with 0 stress. Trauma conditions are permanent; you earn xp when you play one to cause trouble. When you mark your fourth trauma condition, you must retire your character to a different life.
help.harm: Record lesser harm in the bottom row, moderate harm in the middle row, severe harm in the top row. You suffer the penalty at the end of the row if any harm recorded in that row applies to the situation at hand. If the row is already filled, the harm moves up to the next available row. If you run out of spaces on the top row, you suffer a catastrophic, permanent consequence.
help.load: For each job, decide what your character’s load will be — it determines how many items you can carry. During the job, fill in any box on your items list to have that item available, up to the maximum load you have chosen.

muscle.unique: Witnesses confirm feats of near-superhuman strength. Known to take on armed groups hand-to-hand without support.
muscle.wrecking_crew: A name known along the docks. Fights at close quarters with exceptional ferocity; property damage per incident above average.
muscle.ready_for_anything: Ambushes fail: every attempt has met a response prepared in advance.
muscle.scary: Witnesses refuse to testify. Presence alone is intimidating; threats are, as a rule, carried out.
muscle.backup: Works as backup in crew operations: covers, clears the way, steadies accomplices.
muscle.battleborn: Extensive combat experience. Stays cool under fire and walks away from blows that should have been decisive.
muscle.bodyguard: Shields accomplices with own body. Takes wounds with no visible effect.
muscle.predator: Targets the weak and the vulnerable. Gathers intelligence on a target’s weaknesses before striking.
muscle.flesh_wound: Wounds that should mean a hospital bed heal within days. Does not seek medical treatment.

mechanic.unique: Repairs and cracks machinery on the move with whatever is at hand. Reads blueprints faster than staff engineers.
mechanic.bailing_wire_and_mech_tape: The crew’s ship runs on makeshift repairs. No spare parts bought through official channels.
mechanic.analyst: Traces hacked systems back to their owners and their core. Intrusions leave next to no trace in the logs.
mechanic.mechanics_heart: Wins over even hardened criminals. Under questioning, witnesses often speak up in defence.
mechanic.construct_whisperer: Treats machines and robots as if they were alive. Devices assembled carry non-standard modifications.
mechanic.fixed: Equipment failures don’t slow the crew down: breakdowns get fixed mid-operation.
mechanic.junkyard_hunter: Frequents scrapyards and chop shops. Parts salvaged there are as good as factory-made.
mechanic.overclock: Ship systems run above rated specifications. Modifications uncertified.
mechanic.hacker: Suspected in a series of breaches of secured networks. Electronic trails lead elsewhere.

mystic.unique: Practises the forbidden teachings of the Way. Unnaturally calm in a crisis.
mystic.kinetics: Recorded moving objects without physical contact and bursts of speed beyond human ability.
mystic.psy_dancing: Witnesses change their statements after contact; memories of the encounter are vague or missing.
mystic.warded: Mystic attacks and artifacts fail to take effect.
mystic.way_shield: Witnesses describe blaster shots stopped in midair and sent back at the shooter.
mystic.center: Withdraws regularly to meditate. Reports troubling visions afterwards.
mystic.psy_blade: Wields a blade of pure energy that cuts through any metal or armor not protected by a shield.
mystic.sundering: Mass mental casualties recorded in the vicinity: fainting, bleeding, memory loss.
mystic.visions: Holds knowledge of places and people beyond any access. Source of the leak not established.

speaker.unique: Passes for a law-abiding citizen. Deflects suspicion from the crew and acquires useful resources with ease.
speaker.favors_owed: Has done favours for many people of influence; debts are repaid in information and resources.
speaker.player: Attempts to deceive in conversation fail every time.
speaker.disarming: Defuses conflicts with words. Opponents often leave negotiations as allies.
speaker.infiltrator: Bypasses security systems of any grade without raising an alarm.
speaker.heart_to_heart: The crew’s informal leader: accomplices come for advice and follow it.
speaker.old_friends: Contacts in every port of the sector. The circle grows with each visit.
speaker.subterfuge: Under suspicion repeatedly, never detained. Statements are convincing and impossible to verify.
speaker.purpose: Acts with purpose despite superior opposition and wounds. Does not yield to pressure.

pilot.unique: Exceptional piloting skills. Outruns interceptors at top speed.
pilot.keen_eye: Never misses, ship’s guns included. Every witness remarks on the sharp eye.
pilot.punch_it: Takes reckless risks in hopeless situations — and gets away clean.
pilot.hedonist: Lives a life of excess; vices open doors to useful people and information.
pilot.commander: Directs the crew like a military unit. In combat the group fights like a larger force.
pilot.leaf_on_the_wind: Flies manoeuvres at the edge of the possible, at clear personal risk.
pilot.exceed_specs: Burns out the ship’s own systems to get results. Damage is repaired later.
pilot.side_job: Picks up odd jobs in port; sources of income undeclared.
pilot.traveler: At home in alien cultures; maintains contacts among xenos.

scoundrel.unique: The crew enjoys inexplicable luck. Coincidences in its favour are documented consistently.
scoundrel.never_tell_me_the_odds: Takes on hopeless odds — and wins.
scoundrel.devils_own_luck: Walks out of firefights without a scratch. Cannot be held: talks the way out or vanishes.
scoundrel.ask_questions_later: Quickly works out in conversation who stands to gain.
scoundrel.when_the_chips_are_down: In a crisis, slips the consequences again and again.
scoundrel.shoot_first: Opens fire without warning, usually from cover or ambush. No one has been faster yet.
scoundrel.daredevil: A taste for needless risk. Turns desperate situations to advantage.
scoundrel.i_know_a_guy: An informant in every port; details of upcoming jobs are known in advance.
scoundrel.tenacious: Disabling wounds do not stop the subject. Resists arrest to the very end.

stitch.unique: Medical training confirmed. Applies that knowledge far beyond medicine.
stitch.physicker: Forensic skills: reconstructs events from wounds and bodies. Wounded accomplices recover unusually fast.
stitch.welcome_anywhere: Posing as a doctor, goes where others cannot. Aid to the wounded opens any door.
stitch.moral_compass: Follows conscience even at personal cost. Motives are not tied to profit.
stitch.under_pressure: Serious wounds among the crew cause no panic; works only calmer afterwards.
stitch.patch: Treats injuries mid-operation; wounded accomplices keep going.
stitch.combat_medic: Operates under fire. Composure on the battlefield confirmed by witnesses.
stitch.dr_strange: Studies Precursor artifacts and mystic phenomena with no visible harm. The Church of Stellar Flame has been notified.
stitch.book_learning: Speaks many languages; exceptionally well-read. Makes use of archives and libraries.
